overloads.semanticRole: The Find in array command returns the number of the first element in array that matches value .

constraints: The array and value parameters must be of the same type (Text, Numeric, Date, Pointer, Object, or Boolean arrays are supported); with Object arrays only object references can be used for value, not deep equality.
Matching uses the same equality rules as the equality operator (exact match), not a substring/wildcard search.
